title: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Split language models keep input text on a client but send intermediate representations to a server. Attacks can reconstruct text from these messages. Comparing privacy evaluations is difficult when attackers see different messages, know different model weights or use different datasets and recovery measures. We present LLM-Attacker, a framework that records these choices and lets researchers check, compare and extend an evaluation. Compatible attacks reuse recorded messages, and their predictions are saved for independent scoring. The scoring rule requires a linked undefended reference before a defence can pass. Reports also identify attacks that remain untested. In a controlled GPT-2 experiment, adding gradients returned during training increased token recovery from 94.20% to 97.38% and exact-document recovery from 13.71% to 37.77%. The 95% interval for the token gain lay above the two-percentage-point threshold fixed before testing.

translated_title: LLM-Attacker：用于切分式与分布式大语言模型系统隐私评估的统一红队框架
translated_abstract: 切分式语言模型将输入文本保留在客户端，但会将中间表示发送到服务器，攻击者可以从这些消息中重建文本。当攻击者看到不同的消息、掌握不同的模型权重，或使用不同的数据集和恢复度量时，隐私评估之间的比较就变得十分困难。我们提出了LLM-Attacker，一个记录这些攻击选择的框架，使研究人员能够检查、比较和扩展评估。兼容的攻击可以重用已记录的消息，其预测结果会被保存以供独立评分。评分规则要求在防御通过之前必须存在一个关联的无防御参考基线。报告还会识别出尚未经过测试的攻击。在一项受控的GPT-2实验中，添加训练期间返回的梯度使token恢复率从94.20%提升到97.38%，精确文档恢复率从13.71%提升到37.77%。token增益的95%置信区间高于测试前设定的两个百分点阈值。
tldr: 本文提出LLM-Attacker统一红队评估框架，通过记录攻击者的选择实现切分式与分布式大语言模型隐私评估的可复现与可比较，并揭示训练期间返回梯度会使token恢复率从94.20%升至97.38%、精确文档恢复率从13.71%升至37.77%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLM-Attacker, a unified red-team framework that records attacker choices to enable reproducible and comparable privacy evaluation of split and distributed LLM systems, and shows that returning gradients during training increases token recovery from 94.20% to 97.38% and exact-document recovery from 13.71% to 37.77%.
